Name: One Item Bundle
Author: techrifle
Description:
Are you tired of juggling multiple items to complete the Community Center bundles in Stardew Valley? If so, you're in luck! We are excited to introduce a mod that dramatically simplifies the process: the One Item Bundle Mod. This mod reduces the number of items required for bundle completion to just one, making your gameplay experience smoother and more enjoyable. Here’s a detailed look at how this mod works and how it can enhance your Stardew Valley adventure.

[b][size=4]Mod Overview

[/size][/b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OszbH6S.png[/img]

The One-Item Bundle Mod revolutionizes the way you approach the Community Center bundles. Instead of collecting a variety of items to complete each bundle, this mod allows you to finish a bundle with just one item. This means fewer trips to the mines, forests, and farms, and more time enjoying other aspects of the game.

[size=4][b]Key Features[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][b]Streamlined Bundles:[/b] Each bundle now requires only one item instead of the usual multiple items. For example, the [i][b]Spring Foraging Bundle[/b][/i], which originally required [i]Wild Horseradish, Daffodil, Leek, and Dandelion,[/i] can now be completed with just one of these items.
[*][b]Enhanced Gameplay:[/b] By simplifying the bundle requirements, this mod reduces the grind and frustration associated with completing these tasks, making the gameplay more focused on what you enjoy most.
[*][b]Easy Installation:[/b] The mod is compatible with Content Patcher, ensuring a seamless integration with your existing mods and game setup.
[/list][size=4][b]
How It Works[/b][/size]
The mod edits the Data/Bundles file in Stardew Valley, streamlining each bundle's requirements. Here’s a closer look at how it modifies various bundles:
[list]
[*][b]Pantry Bundles: [/b]Simplifies the collection of crops and artisan goods. For example, the Spring Crops bundle now requires only one of the listed crops to complete.
[*][b]Crafts Room Bundles:[/b] Reduces the number of foraging items needed. For instance, the Spring Foraging Bundle now requires just one of the four foraging items.
[*][b]Fish Tank Bundles:[/b] Consolidates the variety of fish required, making it easier to complete each section with fewer catches.
[*][b]Boiler Room Bundles: [/b]Streamlines the collection of minerals and ores needed to complete the bundles.
[*][b]Vault Bundles:[/b] Simplifies the requirements for the various monetary bundles, reducing the amount of gold needed.
[*][b]Abandoned Joja Mart: [/b]This mod also simplifies the Abandoned Joja Mart bundles. Previously, you needed several items to complete these bundles, but now you only need one item per bundle.
[/list][size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][b]Download the Mod: [/b]Obtain the One-Item Bundle Mod from the Nexus Mods website or any other trusted modding site.
[*][b]Install Content Patcher: [/b]Ensure you have Content Patcher installed, as this mod requires it to function correctly.
[*][b]Place the Mod Files: [/b]Copy the mod files into your Stardew Valley mods folder, typically found in Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*][b]Launch the Game: [/b]Start Stardew Valley as usual, and the mod will automatically take effect, simplifying your Community Center bundles.
[/list][center][i]This mod is created by [url=https://techzap.org/]techzap[/url]﻿. Modifying or reuploading this mod without permission is strictly prohibited.
[/i][/center][b][size=4]Conclusion[/size][/b]

The One-Item Bundle Mod is a game-changer for Stardew Valley enthusiasts who want to streamline their Community Center completion efforts. By requiring only one item per bundle, it reduces the grind and makes the game more accessible and enjoyable. Whether you’re a veteran player or new to modding, this mod is sure to enhance your Stardew Valley experience.
Download the One-Item Bundle Mod today and make your journey through Stardew Valley’s Community Center a breeze!
